models.label: Lilguy v0.1 · Transformer
models.description: An early small Transformer experiment. Kept in the library so older chats and model tests remain discoverable.

models.label: Lilguy v0.2 · Context Cache
models.description: A lightweight browser-based next-text experiment using a context table. Runs locally in the browser, but it is not a modern neural language model.

models.label: Lilguy Bluejay v0.3 · Local
models.description: Runs on your own device from GitHub Pages using a small instruction-tuned model. No Python API or hosted chat server. The original from-scratch Bluejay checkpoint remains a separate training experiment and is not loaded by this browser runtime.
capabilities: No chat sent to a server
